headline: Saint Joseph's (Maine) finishes conference play unbeaten
dek: Saint Joseph's (Maine) lost just three times all season, pairing nine wins with eight draws while scoring 42 goals and conceding eighteen. Those draws kept it behind Emmanuel (Mass.) and Rivier in the conference table, even as its late run carried into November before ending at Middlebury.

pattern.text: Scoring concentrates sharply at the top of the conference: Norwich's 42 goals exceed the combined output of Albertus Magnus and New England College, underscoring the gulf between the attacking leaders and the middle and lower tiers.

findings.text: Saint Joseph's (Maine) goalkeeper Alex Bachmann made 105 saves while conceding eighteen goals, posting a 0.854 save percentage.
